note: v1 (26 Nov 2026). Chinese only, Douyin. Voice: the 58 line clips in {VOICE}/v1/lines (E01 = the clearer take), laid by build_voice.py at the house level with the hot syllables' clip gain; it stops if the result is out of step with voice.ts. Sound: the two music cues are made by code into {CLIPS} (make_music.py), then the kit's build.py with scripts/sihang/sound/cues.json (gains set by level_cues.py from the clips the Mac made). Mono mix about -19.4 LUFS, true peak about -2.3 dBTP.

sound.build: python3 scripts/sihang/sound/make_music.py {CLIPS} && python3 scripts/kit/day/sound/build.py --film sihang --work {WORK} --timing {VOICE}/voice_timing.json --voice {VOICE}/voice_48k.wav --clips {CLIPS} --cues scripts/sihang/sound/cues.json --out {MIX}
